# EKAA (ekaa.me) — Ekaa Radiance by Mehak Marwaha
> Dubai-based & worldwide online holistic clarity sanctuary founded by Mehak Marwaha. One Purpose, Many Paths.

## Flagship Services (Ekaa Radiance)
- [Ekaa Radiance Hub](https://ekaa.me/radiance/): Overview of all 7 modalities and interactive session matcher.
- [Vedic Numerology](https://ekaa.me/radiance/vedic-numerology/): 60-minute 1:1 birth chart, Lo Shu Grid & timing consultation.
- [Reiki Healing Energy](https://ekaa.me/radiance/reiki-healing/): 60-minute restorative Reiki in Dubai or distance online.
- [Tarot Life Coaching](https://ekaa.me/radiance/tarot-life-coaching/): Non-predictive reflective coaching for life decisions.
- [Akashic Record Reading](https://ekaa.me/radiance/akashic-records/): Deep soul-level exploration of recurring themes.
- [Pendulum Dowsing](https://ekaa.me/radiance/pendulum-dowsing/): 45-minute intuitive alignment check-in.
- [Meditation Practices](https://ekaa.me/radiance/meditation/): Personalized breathwork and 10-minute daily ritual coaching.
- [Transformative & Crystal Workshops](https://ekaa.me/radiance/workshops/): Curated Dubai & online group circles.
